meta.production_boundary: Production publication/supersession requires a connected provider profile-governance service and immutable evidence. Packaged profiles are read-only reference contracts.

authority.mutation_policy: Only provider/control-plane profile governance may publish or supersede a profile revision. Tenant Admin and Data Engineer consume read-only bindings.

ceds.version_policy: Reference alignment only — no exact release pinned by this profile

custom.version_policy: Connector-owned version; mapping/adapter must be validated against this profile revision

binding_contract.connector_rule: Tenant connector instances must bind an effective Platform Admin profile revision. Binding never transfers profile authority.
binding_contract.mapping_rule: Mappings must bind the same profile id/revision/hash as the tenant connector and governed school-year context. Standard-specific mappings must match the exact required version.
binding_contract.drift_rule: A profile id, revision, contract-hash, school-year, or standard-version mismatch is Revalidation Required and blocks new governed handoff/activation in Production.
binding_contract.upgrade_rule: Publishing a newer profile revision never auto-upgrades existing connector or mapping bindings; explicit revalidation/rebinding is required.
binding_contract.certification_rule: Profile conformance is not connector certification. Connector/product certification remains a separate evidence-backed state.

evidence.source_basis: Current public technology roadmap verified 2026-09-24; connector-specific certification evidence remains separate.
